title: [MAIN] Fix TDS calculation on multi-line purchase invoices (Bug 659187)
summary: Codeunit 18694 and TDS use-case configuration fixed to correctly calculate tax-deducted-at-source on multi-line purchase invoices by retaining untaxed amounts from earlier lines when the annual threshold is reached.
key_points: TDS calculation was incorrectly excluding earlier untaxed lines when the cumulative invoice total hit the annual threshold
The fix preserves line-level TDS bases and ensures all applicable amounts are included in the calculation
Use-case configuration updated from version 35 to 36 to implement the corrected logic
Prevents scenarios where only later lines are taxed while earlier amounts are overlooked
Resolution applies specifically to Indian localization TDS workflows
quote: Retain earlier untaxed amounts when the annual threshold is reached, while excluding amounts already taxed under the per-contract rule.
